# BKG location overrides — manually maintained (NOT auto-generated).
#
# LEGACY: production ignores this file. The live site publishes the
# administration-owned roster (docs/JSON-INPUT.md), whose reviewed QTHs
# are authoritative; correct them in bkg-automation instead. Entries here
# apply only to an explicit `scripts/build-roster.py --source sheets` build.
#
# Override the location bkg.club places a member at, replacing what the QRZ
# XML lookup reports. Use this when a member's QRZ QTH is stale (they moved
# but never updated their QRZ address). QRZ stays the source of truth for
# everyone else; the override just wins at build time. This is the location
# counterpart of name-overrides.txt, and anyone can add or edit entries here.
#
# One entry per line:
#
#     CALLSIGN = UT              (two-letter US state code)
#     CALLSIGN = Canada          (anything else is a DXCC country name)
#
# - Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# - The separator may be '=' or ':'.
# - Callsigns are matched case-insensitively.
# - An entry for a callsign not (yet) in the roster is harmless — it just
#   applies the moment that callsign appears.
#
# Affects the territory map, the state/country OG badges (the OG is simply
# the lowest-numbered member in each territory, so moving a member out of a
# state hands the OG badge to the next-earliest member there), and the
# leaderboard, on the next build (scripts/build-roster.py).

# N1ZKW has lived in California for a while, but his QRZ address was never
# updated from his old South Dakota QTH. Moving him to CA makes KF0CZD
# (BKG422) the SD OG, as he should be.
N1ZKW = CA
